Analysis of the Dataset

The dataset contains a total of 14,952 events recorded from 381 unique users over the period from November 27, 2025 to February 22, 2026. There are 109 different event types captured in this dataset.

Workflow Volume Analysis

The following table summarizes the event volume and user penetration for each defined workflow:

  • Hisab (Accounting): 12,349 events (82.6% of total events)
  • Dashboard: 1,592 events (10.6% of total events)
  • Login / Auth: 253 events (1.7% of total events)
  • Cash Settlement: 4 events (0.0% of total events)
  • Push Notifications: 0 events (0.0% of total events)

Operational Focus

The Hisab (Accounting) workflow has the highest event volume, accounting for over 82.6% of total events. This indicates that operators are heavily engaged in accounting-related tasks, suggesting that this is a critical area for operational focus. The significant volume of events in this workflow may reflect the importance of financial tracking and management for operators.

Critical Funnels: Login / Auth Workflow Analysis

Analyzing the Login / Auth funnel, we observe the following stages and conversion rates:

  • Page View: 79 events
  • OTP Request: 60 events (Conversion: 75.9%)
  • OTP Verify: 42 events (Conversion: 70.0%)
  • Success: 30 events (Conversion: 71.4%)

The biggest drop-off occurs between the OTP Request and OTP Verify stages, where the conversion rate drops from 75.9% to 70.0%, indicating a potential area for improvement in the verification process.

Operator Behavior

The analysis indicates that the workflows are not highly concentrated among a few "power operators." The distribution of events across various workflows suggests that a broader range of operators are engaging with the platform, particularly in the Hisab (Accounting) workflow.

Untracked Activity

Notably, the Push Notifications workflow shows no recorded events, indicating a potential area of untracked activity or lack of engagement with push notifications. This could be an opportunity for further investigation into why operators are not interacting with this feature.
